title: Key West Beach Elopement Intimate Wedding All Inclusive
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our beach elopement package is designed for couples who want a meaningful wedding experience without the stress an expense of planning a large celebration.

Our personal approach allows you to relax and enjoy the moment rather than worrying about what comes next. Whether this is your first wedding, a destination elopement, or a vow renewal you can celebrate your love in a beautiful place we like to call paradise. We will help make your experience feel personal and memorable.

Before your ceremony you'll receive information about your experience, along with any resources you might need including: Marriage license information , Scooter and golf cart discounts, Hair and makeup services that can be contracted, etc. so that you can arrive prepared and relaxed.

This package is perfect for 2-10 guests, but can accommodate up to 30. We are happy to quote for add-ons including: Arch, chairs, Music, etc.
